xlsx_cross_reader.method: independent XLSX ZIP/XML versus openpyxl data_only true/false, all stored nonempty cells including excluded sheets; number-format definitions compared semantically, raw XML style indexes retained separately because openpyxl normalizes/deduplicates ids/merged borders; no private text emitted

comparison.source_first_status: Source expectations were frozen before producer data/schema read; not blind because initial counts/conflict rules had been provided. Explicit source-first follow-ups and reviewer corrections are preserved in this report.

limits: 已知初步數量與衝突規則，seen_initial=true；這是原件先行的獨立程式核對，不稱盲校。
ODS逐格核對原存text:p、typed value／string、公式、style、number-format參照、merge與定位；XLSX另以openpyxl核對全267個非空原件格，但未用原生試算表軟體渲染或重算。
XLSX數字的渲染顯示字串並未儲存在原XML；只驗證快取值、公式及格式定義，未宣稱驗證軟體實際畫面。
已核對指定工作表統計格及公開cells格網的完整性；未把範本、古蹟統計、聯絡背景或非統計頁尾轉成營運觀測。
不同借閱表的業務母體或計數定義仍依原文保留疑義，不證明跨表可加總或互比；2026月報不當全年值。
本審查不重新認定下載授權；公開範圍仍須沿用各來源已確認或待確認的權利分層。

corrections: Initial generic pre-footer range included the completely blank separator B21:I21 on 72 reader sheets (576 blank non-statistical positions); source row labels show data ends A20, A21 is blank, footer begins A22. Exclude that separator, preserve every actual data row.
Compare XLSX number-format definitions rather than openpyxl generated style IDs; raw original XML style index remains authoritative and retained.

source_semantic_followup.reason: Initial reviewer regex incorrectly matched the trailing 109 inside 1109; corrected against original XML after parent noted literal token; producer/source values unchanged.
C6 explicitly prints 總計; C7 prints generic 館別. Entity label uses original C6 and full hierarchy retains both, not a guessed geography.

confirmed_noncontact_identifiers_retaine.reason: original printed table identifier, not a telephone; retained as provenance

correction_replay.method: For the final cell files only, restore exactly the eight specified header fields to their previous CSV-empty / JSONL-null representations, reproduce the original serializer, and compare the entire reconstructed bytes to the recorded original SHA256. No original file or producer output is written. Exact old-byte hashes prove all other fields, row order and formatting unchanged.

reviewer_contract_corrections.reason: Numeric XLSX XML supplies cached lexical values and number formats, not rendered display strings. Check source_display_raw empty, cached value_raw and original number format separately; never claim visual display verification.
An absent XML cell has no explicitly printed number-format metadata; expect an empty raw number-format field rather than infer General.
Header hierarchy must retain the original stored whitespace in row8/row9; reviewer removed strip normalization from the comparison. Numeric expectations unchanged.
